calls.video_title: Nike Stock at a 13-Year Low: Bargain or Value Trap?
calls.thesis: Not getting in at ~$34: stock -81% from ATH / at a 13-year low, but adjusted P/E ~22, P/FCF ~36 on ~$1.4bn FCF, and the ~5% dividend ($2.4bn) exceeds FCF so it is paid from reserves; margins collapsed to <7% on inventory clearance, Vietnam tariffs (~12.5%) and competition. First tracked German Value Investor NKE call - no flip.
calls.base_case: Normal scenario: 7% earnings growth for 5y then 9%, fair P/E 12 -> fair price ~10% below current, ~5-6%/yr returns over 10y ('okay, not great').
calls.bull_case: Positive scenario: 20% growth for 5y then 9%, fair P/E 15 -> fair price ~$60, >80% upside, ~15%/yr.
calls.bear_case: Negative scenario: earnings -7%/yr for 5y, fair P/E 7 -> fair price ~$8.50 (-75%). He weights the negative scenario heavily for margin of safety.

calls.video_title: Nike Stock: Buy, Hold, or Sell? (My Final Verdict) | NKE Stock Deep Dive Part 5
calls.thesis: Final verdict (Part 5): NOT a buying opportunity now. FY27 revenue guided down high single digits (-7/8/9%) and worsening through the year and into FY28 (he had expected improvement), operating income likely -15 to -20%; FV cut again to $26.60 (from $29 on 2026-10-02). Not interested anywhere near $35; more interested closer to $25 or on improved performance. HOLD reiterated vs his 2026-10-02 HOLD - no flip.
calls.base_case: Revenue -7 to -9% in FY27 with later quarters worse; profits fall by a larger percentage than revenue.
calls.bull_case: None given in this part; interest only closer to $25 or once performance actually improves.
calls.bear_case: Management may guide FY28 as another down year; competitive position arguably the worst in decades, forward P/E 20 is cheapest in years for a reason.

calls.thesis: Passing: revenue $51B->$45B in full-on contraction, net income and EPS declining for ~5 years, brand fading with younger shoppers vs competent rivals; stock still at a higher multiple than the turnaround buys. First NKE call on record.
